test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A 600-metre-long train is running at a speed of 48 km/h. It crosses a platform completely in 4 minutes and 30 seconds. What is the length of the platform?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of train = 600 meter

Speed of the train = 48 km/h

Time is taken by train to cross plate form = 270 sec

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

Speed of the train = 48 km/h

or Speed of the train = 48 km/h × 5/18 

= 40/3 m/s

The train crosses its length in time = 600over40/3

= 15 × 3 

= 45 sec

Let the plate form length is X meter

According to the question,

So the train crosses the plate form in 270 sec with its length of 600 meters and speed of 40/3 m/s

(600 + X)over 40/3 = 270

⇒ 600 + X = 270 × 40/3

⇒ 600 + X = 3600 

⇒ X = 3000 meters

**∴ The Platform length is 3000 meters.**

3→ 40

3 × 75→ 40 × 75

225→ 3000
